notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-c47dd2ce9a62, DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2020.02023, PMCID PMC7469538. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the Naples shallow-water hydrothermal vent study.
source_text: Nematodes were directly frozen at -80 C. DNA was extracted using the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue kit following manufacturer's instructions. The extraction used a spin column. Partial fragments of 18S rRNA (597 bp) and the 28S rRNA gene (654 bp) were amplified. The PCR cycles were 2 min at 94 C followed by 30 cycles of 1 min denaturation at 94 C, 1 min annealing at 55 C and 2 min extension at 72 C, with a final 10 min extension at 72 C.
